realProcesses: model-runtime HTTP service with protocol-level provider
execution-runtime HTTP service with SQLite recovery
platform-host HTTP service with real Task/Agent owner packages
agent-gateway HTTP service with file-backed role credentials

contractPairs.Task-Agent: Task/Worker binding is created by the Task owner and validated by the Agent owner before Execution routing.
contractPairs.Task-Execution: Task and worker identity cross Host transport into the durable Execution request.
contractPairs.Execution-Model: Execution REVIEW admission invokes Model Runtime inference and consumes a successful typed decision observation.
contractPairs.Agent-Execution: Authenticated Agent role and bound worker are validated before Execution invocation.
contractPairs.AgentGateway-TaskExecution: Bearer authentication injects role identity; product creates Task and controller executes through owner routes.

recovery: Execution Runtime restart reopens the same SQLite record as SUCCEEDED.
Foreign library error codes are normalized to the frozen EXECUTION_FAILED vocabulary.

actual.providerInteraction: Observed capability probes plus an Execution-triggered Model inference
actual.identitySpoofing: Gateway credential identity overrides callerRef and roleRef

limits: The protocol provider is a controlled local provider; historical committed real-provider evidence remains the external Model basis.
This test does not contain Chrome, ChatGPT Web, g-id, c-id, physical submit, or collaboration delivery.
